g.text: inlet: tube end above liquid (air gap)
ESP32 #1 (U2): SV1-SV4, PWM_1-4 to pumps, START switch
ESP32 #2 (U7): FT1-FT3 pulse inputs · UART link U2 ⇄ U7
MDD10A DRV1: P1 + P2 · MDD10A DRV2: P3 + P4
BV-M / BV-J are hand valves: BATCH = M open, J shut;
FLUSH = M shut, J open. Pin under each symbol = PCB pin.
SV pins on ESP32 #1 (U2), HIGH = open.

svg.text: P&ID · Chocolate batch plant · Team 13 · rev C
Dose order Yellow 300 mL → Green 900 mL → Red 1,800 mL → water chase (BV-M) · flush to J-1 (BV-J) · 4 solenoid valves
